en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard with a wide view of a town square, featuring scattered wooden buildings, a prominent round building with a conical roof to the right, and several church spires in the background. The foreground contains handwritten text in what appears to be Swedish. The word 'Hamina' is printed at the top left of the postcard, with 'Koitär, Hamina' and 'E. P. foto.' printed at the bottom.
